definitions.explanation: Strong and barely controllable emotion; intense enthusiasm or dedication to something.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{音楽|おんがく}に{情熱|じょうねつ}を{注|そそ}いでいる。
examples.english: He pours his passion into music.

examples.japanese: {若|わか}い{頃|ころ}の{情熱|じょうねつ}を{忘|わす}れてはいけない。
examples.english: You shouldn't forget the passion of your youth.

examples.japanese: {情熱|じょうねつ}を{持|も}って{仕事|しごと}に{取|と}り{組|く}む。

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {情熱|じょうねつ}を{注|そそ}ぐ (to pour one's passion into)
- {情熱|じょうねつ}を{持|も}つ (to have passion)
- {情熱|じょうねつ}を{燃|も}やす (to burn with passion)
- {情熱的|じょうねつてき} (passionate - adjective form)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {熱意|ねつい} - enthusiasm, zeal (more controlled)
- {熱情|ねつじょう} - passionate emotion (literary)
